# Guide third-party notices

The guide serves Inter, JetBrains Mono and the Lucide Activity icon from the
same copies bundled in DriveLink’s desktop app. Their versions and upstream
sources appear in [GUI resource sources](https://github.com/taruntom1/drivelink_v2/blob/main/host/gui/resources/SOURCES.md).
The accompanying license files are available beside this notice.

The ESP Web Tools 10.5.2 browser distribution comes from the
[upstream npm archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/esp-web-tools/-/esp-web-tools-10.5.2.tgz).
The archive SHA-256 is
`35681b4f1910a95f51a592ad9701f059ff60d2902ad94df9e1ad7ee59ab6b7ca`.
The JavaScript files are taken unchanged from `package/dist/web/`.
ESP Web Tools is Apache-2.0. Its browser distribution bundles Improv Serial
SDK, Material Web, esptool-js, Pako, Lit, and tslib. The accompanying license
texts are taken from the exact packages in the
[upstream lockfile](https://github.com/esphome/esp-web-tools/blob/10.5.2/package-lock.json).

The search index and interface are built by
[Pagefind 1.6.0](https://github.com/Pagefind/pagefind/tree/v1.6.0), MIT.
The accompanying Pagefind license applies to the bundled search assets.
